text: A Metro day ticket costs £2. What do you pay for you and two friends?
Which of these isn't a real day of the week: Wednesday, Funday, Friday, Monday?
why: The other three are real days.

text: Sausage rolls come in packs of 4. You need 22 for a party. How many packs must you buy?
why: 5 packs give only 20, so you need a sixth.

text: Take eighteen, cut it in half, multiply by two and finally add one. Result?
why: Halving then doubling gets you back to 18; add 1 for 19.

text: Gossip spreads: 3 people know at 9am, 6 by 10am and 12 by 11am. If it keeps doubling, how many know by noon?
Sunderland to Newcastle is about 12 miles. Walking at 3 miles an hour, how many hours will it take?
A pub quiz team of 6 shares a £45 prize equally. How much does each person get?
What's the most Sundays a 31-day month can have?
why: 31 days is 4 weeks and 3 days, so three weekdays appear five times.

text: Which month of the year has the shortest name?
why: Three letters, one fewer than June or July.
